rule: Fixed before any result existed. calibration: used only to calibrate compressed builds (#271 step 2), never scored. test: the only recordings ever scored. Each set is scored on its own, never pooled (their references differ).

ami.corpus: AMI Meeting Corpus (CC BY 4.0), Array1-01: one microphone of the table array, the far-field case
ami.note: calibration = AMI dev, test = AMI test; no speakers in common; Sortformer v2.1 was trained on AMI train, which is in neither list.

chime6.corpus: CHiME-6 (CC BY-SA 4.0), dinner parties in homes; one Kinect array, channel 1, per window (the reference array of most of the window's utterances)
chime6.reference: CHiME6_transcriptions (OpenSLR 150) utterance boundaries, cut into 600 s windows (speaker_eval/chime6.py)
chime6.note: calibration = dev sessions S02, S09; test = eval sessions S01, S21; different people. Not in Sortformer v2.1's training list.
